NO SMALL PRINT SURPRISES

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Transport charges should be easy to understand.

How are fees calculated?+

These sample plans use the route’s distance band. The calculator applies 65% of the monthly return fee to a one-way journey. A real operator must confirm their own rates and terms.

Can I pay from the parent dashboard?+

The dashboard lets you preview a fee payment and download a sample receipt. No card, UPI or bank information is requested, and no real payment takes place.

Is there a term discount?+

The sample term estimate is three monthly fees, with no discount assumed. Any real offers or school agreements should be confirmed separately.

What about holidays, changes or cancellations?+

A real service agreement should explain holiday charges, notice periods, route changes and refunds before enrolment. No booking or contract is created by this demo.
